remarks: A rare opportunity to build a fully custom estate-style home by Brownstone Homes on a secluded, wooded 3-acre homesite in Orchard Park. Surrounded by mature trees and natural scenery, the property offers an exceptional level of privacy and a peaceful setting tucked away from the activity of everyday life, while still located approximately 10 minutes from the new Highmark Stadium. This proposed Modern Transitional Estate offers approximately 5,200 square feet of finished living space with 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 1 half bathroom. The striking exterior features a dramatic covered entry, a refined combination of stone and board-and-batten siding, architectural detailing, and a side-load 3-car garage designed to complement the overall character of the home. The first floor is centered around a spacious great room with a fireplace and an open kitchen featuring an oversized center island, quartz countertops, premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large walk-in pantry. A formal dining room, private office or den, mudroom, laundry room, and powder room complete the main level. All 4 bedrooms are located on the 2nd floor, including an impressive primary suite with a large walk-in closet and a luxury bathroom featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and tiled shower. One additional bedroom includes its own private bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms share a third full bathroom. The finished lower level provides additional recreation and entertaining space, with the option to add another bedroom and full bathroom. Buyers may choose to build this proposed floor plan, modify it to better suit their needs, or work with Brownstone Homes to create an entirely different custom residence designed around their vision. Final plans, specifications, materials, pricing, and square footage are subject to change. Renderings and images include altered representations of the proposed home or photographs from prior completed Brownstone homes. Taxes to be determined by the town after completion.
